# SimConfig { #ambdes.SimConfig }

```python
SimConfig(
    ambsys_data,
    resource_hours_per_week=52000,
    mean_time_to_scene=10,
    on_scene_time=44,

```

Configuration for a simulation run.

Stores input data and run settings used by the model.
